title: T-3 DO facade opens against env.CELL and env.HUB and emits namespaceReady
asA: shelf consumer applying the platform-cloudflare-durable-objects v1.0.0 blueprint on a Workers project using the cf-platform fixture
iWant: one DO facade module (src/do-facade.mjs) that opens against env.CELL and env.HUB on boot, wires the injected event sink and emits a namespaceReady lifecycle event with a metadata-only payload
soThat: boot ordering is observable, the DO namespace seam is a single call site, and the applied project can compose its own bootstrapping around one predictable event

acceptanceCriteria.description: On process boot, createDoFacadeInProcess (the in-process seam over the shipped facade code path) wires the injected event sink and emits a namespaceReady event on the sink with a payload of exactly {event, key, size, ttl, timestamp} where key is null, size is 0 and ttl is null. facade.cell(name) and facade.hub(name) return the registered SingleCellObject and HubObject instances.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a facade wired with in-process SingleCellObject and HubObject instances and a spy event sink
acceptanceCriteria.then: a namespaceReady event fires exactly once on the sink with the metadata-only payload; the registered handles return the instances
